bear_case.title: The revenue gap
bear_case.description: Hyperscalers are on pace to deploy ~$660–690B of capex in 2026 against ~$51B of direct AI revenue generated — roughly a 10:1 ratio, versus 2.4:1 when cloud computing was at a similar adoption stage in 2011.

bear_case.title: Off-balance-sheet obligations
bear_case.description: Moody's flags ~$662B of signed-but-not-commenced data-center lease commitments sitting off hyperscaler balance sheets.

bear_case.title: Circular financing
bear_case.description: Interlocking vendor-equity stakes and take-or-pay compute deals among NVIDIA, Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic, Oracle and CoreWeave — echoing the Lucent/Nortel vendor-financing dynamics of 1999–2001 — make end-demand look larger and more independent than it is.

bear_case.title: Depreciation clock
bear_case.description: Hyperscalers depreciate AI hardware over 5–6 years, but bears (Michael Burry among them) argue the chips' real economic life is closer to 1–3 years — an estimated ~$176B understatement of depreciation across 2026–2028 that flatters reported earnings.

bear_case.title: Concentration everywhere
bear_case.description: AI is simultaneously the market's largest index weight, VC's largest allocation (86% of $412.7B H1 2026 US venture funding), and this hub's connective thread — a drawdown would hit robotics, nuclear, storage, and quantum sentiment at once.

catalysts.title: SpaceX IPO (largest ever)
catalysts.description: Priced at $135, popped 19% to $161, peaked near $225 — now trading ~$124 (~$1.74T mkt cap) after a scrubbed Starship test. Brings xAI/Grok public by extension.

catalysts.title: Anthropic and OpenAI file confidential S-1s
catalysts.description: Anthropic filed first; OpenAI reportedly may wait until 2027 to actually list. Sets up the AI complex's first real public-market valuation test.

catalysts.title: Earnings season in full swing
catalysts.description: Intel, GM, Danaher, Capital One and others report; investors want monetization evidence, not just capex headlines. Alphabet already slid on reports Gemini's next model is running months behind.

catalysts.title: Hyperscaler earnings + capex guides
catalysts.description: MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/META quarterly capex guidance is the sector's heartbeat; Meta already raised its 2026 range to $125–145B — any further deceleration or acceleration signal moves everything.

catalysts.title: Chinese model competition
catalysts.description: Moonshot AI's new model narrowed the gap with top US offerings and pressured semiconductor stocks — a live check on the "US compute moat" thesis.

catalysts.title: Anthropic revenue trajectory
catalysts.description: $47B run rate vs $10B a year ago — whether this pace holds is the bull case's strongest evidence.
